title: North-West Frontier Province Local Government Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Local Government Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2010
ACT III OF 2010
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier
Province
Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
30th January, 2010]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Bilis/2010/3981,
dated 30-1-2010.-The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment)
Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on 25th January, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on 28th January, 2010 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001), to provide for transitional
arrangements in the interregnum to next election o f local government;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come into
force at once.

No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Bilis/2010/3981,
dated 30-1-2010.-The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment)
Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on 25th January, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on 28th January, 2010 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001), to provide for transitional
arrangements in the interregnum to next election o f local government;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
2. Insertion of
section 179-B in N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001.---In the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001), after
section 179-A, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:-
"179-B.
Dissolution of Local Councils and Transitional Arrangements.---(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in this
Ordinance, the Government may, on coming into force of the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010, by notification in the
Official Gazette, shall dissolve the Zilla Councils, Tehsil Councils, Town Councils and Union Councils and in
consequence thereof all Nazimeen, Naib
Nazimeen and other members of Zilla
Councils, Tehsil Councils, Town Councils and Union
Councils in the province shall cease to hold their respective offices on the
said date.
(2) Soon after the
dissolution of the Local Councils, the Government shall appoint an
Administrator for a local government, who shall perform functions and exercise
powers, under this Ordinance or any other law, of the Nazim,
Naib Nazim and Local
Council of the concerned local government.
(3) The Government
may from time to time issue directions to the Administrators in the performance
of their functions or exercise of powers".
